plugins.name: spire-pipeline
plugins.description: Three-stage build pipeline plus a first-run setup helper: design-swarm (divergence-first design), run-list (durable multi-session build planning), conductor (tiered execution with probe-verified ticks), setup (two-question onboarding to a working config). One engine, config-swappable.

plugins.name: model-vetting
plugins.description: A paired model-vetting set for AI model artifacts: model-scorecard (zero-friction triage over the public HuggingFace API — weight format, custom code, a coarse (format, loader) risk tier, no token and no download) and model-eval (the deep static read for custom-code models — deterministic collector, dual-pass behavioral claim checked against the actual call graph, generation-to-sink traces, plain-English report). Executes nothing from the artifact; never issues a clearance.
